transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Well... I'm just having some trouble at work. People will ask me a simple question, like when a ring repair will be ready, and... I don't know. My answer just wanders. I start talking about invoices, and then somehow it turns into garden soil, or... mortgage papers. I can see them losing me. So... I'm here.
Do you believe that anyone is trying to harm you or plot against you?

Harm me? No. Not harm. 

...I know it sounds odd, but... I just don't trust some of the customers lately. They ask way too many questions. Mostly about the new showroom. My husband says they’re only being friendly, but... I don't know. I've gotten convinced they’re actually coming in just to check whether I’ll miss my payments. 

But no one is trying to physically hurt me, no.
Have there been times when your mood felt unusually high, excited, or irritable for days at a time?
No. I don't think so. I just... no, I haven't felt like that.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is around?

Um... sometimes. 

Just... when the shop is really quiet. I'll hear a woman muttering my name. It sounds like it's coming from the polishing room. And... sometimes I smell burning metal, even when all the torches are completely off. 

It feels real enough that I usually go back there to check. But... no one is there.
Have you been diagnosed with any neurological condition, such as epilepsy or a brain injury?
No. Nothing like that. Just... no.
Have you noticed your memory getting worse lately?
No... not really. I think it's fine.
When you talk and your thoughts seem to wander, does it feel like your thoughts are getting mixed up or hard to keep in order?

I guess so... yes. It's actually why I made the appointment. 

Like... a customer will ask me something simple. Just... when their ring repair will be done. And I try to answer, but... my mind just sort of drifts. I'll start talking about the invoices, and then... somehow I'm talking about the soil in my garden, or the mortgage papers. 

I can just... I can see them looking at me, like they've completely lost track of what I'm saying. It's... embarrassing.
Have these experiences been going on for at least a month?

Yes... longer than a month. I think it's been... maybe a year and eight months ago? That's when it all kind of started. The... the voices. And noticing odd smells. Just... worrying that the customers are watching us. So... yes. A while.
Since these problems began, have you been less able to manage your work or daily responsibilities than before?

Yes. It's... it's been harder. 

I've had to... cut back on the custom pieces. I keep missing the repair deadlines. And... like I said, I lose track when I'm consulting with clients. My husband has to double-check the invoices now. I used to do all of that myself.
During this time, have you had a period of at least two weeks when you felt depressed most of the day nearly every day?

Yes... I suppose so. Most mornings, I just... wake up with this flat, heavy sadness. It feels like... like the color has completely drained out of the house. And that's... before I even get to the shop. It's just there.
Has that depressed mood lasted most of the time during these last year and eight months?

Yes... it has. It's not just a bad week here or there. Most of this time... it's just been part of the day. The heaviness... not sleeping well. Not wanting to eat much. And just... feeling bad about all of it. It's just... been there. Most of the time.
